title.narrative: Countering Human Rights Violations in oPt through Legal Aid, Awareness and Reform

description.narrative:
This is a contribution for 2018 to JLAC's core work providing legal aid and support to Palestinians living in the West Bank. This fund is in addition to CAFOD's co-financing and support provided under the EU project, ICD787.
An assessment carried out in 2014 indicated a need for action to mitigate “push factors” fostering displacement of Palestinians from large expanses of Palestinian land in the West Bank and from the city of Jerusalem. Such push factors include house demolition, forced displacement, and confiscation of land in Area C, and social and economic pressures involving East Jerusalem. Strategies being implemented to address these issues involve rendering legal aid, combined with awareness-raising and advocacy efforts to strengthen the resilience of marginalized communities at risk for displacement. Ongoing engagement with civil society coalitions, local government, community leaders and community based organisations ensures that the people affected are fully participant in the mitigation process, and that their prioritizations and input are continually sought during service provision and evaluations.
